Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Clyde Drexler?

Clyde Drexler is 64 years old.

Where was Clyde Drexler born?

Clyde Drexler was born in New Orleans, Louisiana.

When was Clyde Drexler born?

Clyde Drexler was born on June 22, 1962.

How tall is Clyde Drexler?

Clyde Drexler is 6-7 (201 cm) tall.

How much did Clyde Drexler weigh when playing?

Clyde Drexler weighed 210 lbs (95 kg) when playing.

Is Clyde Drexler in the Hall of Fame?

Clyde Drexler was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2004 (Full List) .

When was Clyde Drexler drafted?

Clyde Drexler was drafted by Portland Trail Blazers, 1st round (14th pick, 14th overall), 1983 NBA Draft.

What position did Clyde Drexler play?

Shooting Guard.

When did Clyde Drexler retire?

Clyde Drexler last played in 1998.

What is Clyde Drexler's net worth?

Clyde Drexler made at least $31,147,000 playing professional basketball.

How much did Clyde Drexler make?

Clyde Drexler made $9,810,000 in 1996.

What did Clyde Drexler average?

Clyde Drexler averaged 20.4 points, 6.1 rebounds, and 5.6 assists per game.

How many rings does Clyde Drexler have?

Clyde Drexler won one championship.

What schools did Clyde Drexler attend?

Clyde Drexler attended Sterling in Houston, Texas and Houston.

What are Clyde Drexler's nicknames?

Clyde the Glide is a nickname for Clyde Drexler.
